newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firm on overnight cargo bids.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firm on overnight cargo bids.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices edged higher on Thursday due to firmer cargo bids late Wednesday, traders said.
"All bunker prices are quoted above $100 today at the back of higher cargo prices," said one trader, adding that cargo bids had risen by $4-$5.50 per tonne to $97.00 late Wedenesday.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted $108 and 380-cst was at $102 per tonne. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $190-$195 and $200-$205 respectively.
The market would largely depend on crude prices in the near term, traders said. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3751)
